description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket class, which implements a socket-based HTTP client adapter for the Zend Framework. It manages socket connections, stream contexts, and handles HTTP request/response communication over sockets.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket
classes.description: A socket-based HTTP client adapter implementing connection management, request writing, and response reading functionalities.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options for the socket adapter.

methods.name: setStreamContext
methods.description: Sets the stream context for the socket connection.

methods.name: getStreamContext
methods.description: Gets the current stream context, creating a default if none is set.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the specified host and port, with optional SSL.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over the socket connection.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the HTTP response from the socket connection.

methods.name: _checkSocketReadTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the socket read operation timed out and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a stream resource for writing the response body.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the socket if not persistent.
